summary: Replaced Arcode's regex SQL rewriter with safe parser-backed T-SQL and Snowflake formatting previews.
details: The Arcode Format command and ArcBot SQL Format Validation skill now share the same dialect-aware formatter.
Formatting preserves protected SQL text and leaves the source unchanged when parsing or safety checks fail.
ArcBot opens deterministic SQL diffs immediately, uses structured AI review results, and streams normal chat responses as they arrive.
ArcBot reuses one warm Codex app-server process with fresh per-request threads and hardened cancellation and transport recovery.
